title: AgentTTS: Large Language Model Agent for Test-time Compute-optimal Scaling Strategy in Complex Tasks
authors_zh: Fali Wang、Hui Liu、Zhenwei Dai、Jingying Zeng、Zhiwei Zhang、Zongyu Wu、Chen Luo、Zhen Li、Xianfeng Tang、Qi He、Suhang Wang（机构：The Pennsylvania State University、Amazon）
paper_type_zh: 多阶段测试时计算分配研究（NeurIPS 2025）
best_for_zh: 研究多步骤语言模型工作流中模型规模、采样次数与总推理预算分配的读者。
one_line: AgentTTS uses an LLM agent and execution feedback to find compute-optimal model and sampling allocations across dependent stages of a complex task.
AgentTTS 通过语言模型智能体和执行反馈，在多阶段复杂任务中搜索模型选择与重复采样预算的计算最优分配。
why: It turns test-time scaling from one-model sampling into a joint decision over stage order, model size, and sampling budgets.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly searches how a fixed inference budget should be allocated across dependent subtasks, models, and repeated samples.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Most test-time scaling studies treat a task as one stage: select a model, draw more answers, or make one chain longer. Real workflows are often pipelines, such as retrieval followed by answering, requirements followed by code and tests, or decomposition followed by tool use. A budget spent at an early stage can improve the evidence available later, while a poor early result may force a later stage to consume more samples or a larger model.

This paper asks how to allocate a fixed inference budget across such dependent stages. A decision is a vector of per-subtask model choices and sampling budgets, constrained by total cost. The objective is not simply to maximize one local score, but to maximize final task performance while accounting for model-size preference, diminishing returns from repeated sampling, and the way an upstream choice changes the downstream task. Exhaustively evaluating this combinatorial space is costly, so the paper focuses on how to search it efficiently.

多数测试时扩展研究把任务视为单一阶段：选择一个模型、抽取更多答案，或让一条推理链变得更长。真实工作流往往是流水线，例如先检索再回答、先写需求再编写代码和测试，或先分解再调用工具。花在早期阶段的预算能够改善后续可获得的证据，而糟糕的早期结果可能迫使后续阶段使用更多样本或更大的模型。

本文研究如何在这种相互依赖的阶段之间分配固定推理预算。一个决策是由每个子任务的模型选择和采样预算组成的向量，并受总成本约束。目标不只是最大化某一局部分数，而是在考虑模型规模偏好、重复采样的边际递减，以及上游选择如何改变下游任务的情况下最大化最终任务表现。穷举这种组合空间成本很高，因此论文重点讨论如何高效搜索它。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The paper treats compute allocation as an iterative experiment rather than a fixed heuristic. It first derives three empirical guides: different subtasks prefer different model capacities, repeated sampling has a task-specific optimum rather than unlimited benefit, and the quality of an earlier stage changes the compute needed by later stages. These guides make a budget allocation a causal workflow decision, not a collection of independent knobs.

AgentTTS operationalizes this view with an Agent, an Archive, and an Environment. The Agent proposes allocations and textual search guidelines; the Environment runs those allocations on a small task set and returns metric feedback; the Archive retains trials, feedback, and guidelines for subsequent proposals. The central record is therefore an allocation trial: task and subtasks, chosen model and sample count at each stage, normalized cost, executed outputs, evaluation feedback, and the next search decision.

论文把计算分配视为迭代实验，而不是固定启发式规则。它先归纳三条经验指引：不同子任务偏好不同模型能力；重复采样存在任务特定的最优点，而非无限收益；更早阶段的质量会改变后续阶段所需计算。这些指引使预算分配成为因果性的工作流决策，而不是一组彼此独立的旋钮。

AgentTTS 通过智能体、档案和环境三个部分实现这一观点。智能体提出分配方案和文字化搜索指引；环境在小任务集上运行方案并返回指标反馈；档案为下一轮提案保留试验、反馈和指引。因此，核心记录是一条分配试验：任务及子任务、每个阶段选择的模型与采样数、归一化成本、实际执行输出、评估反馈，以及下一次搜索决策。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each complex task, the authors enumerate a model pool ranging from 3B to 72B parameters and represent budget in normalized inference FLOPs. A larger model with fewer samples can then be compared with a smaller model sampled more often, while prompt and generation length differences across stages are included in cost conversion. The scaling primitive is repeated sampling with fusion: samples are drawn at temperature 0.9 and the same language model fuses candidate responses, avoiding an additional reward model or verifier.

The search agent begins with model-preference trials, receives execution feedback, stores it in the Archive, and turns the three empirical insights into guidelines for later proposals. The Environment executes each candidate allocation on the actual task platform. Reported experiments cover retrieval-based QA, knowledge-graph QA, task automation, and automated software development across six datasets; each method runs 50 search iterations using 50 training examples and is evaluated on 500 test examples, with GPT-o3-mini as the search agent. The official repository includes the four task families’ data and adapted execution code.

对于每个复杂任务，作者列出从 3B 到 72B 参数的模型池，并用归一化推理 FLOPs 表示预算。这样，较大模型的较少样本可与较小模型的更多样本比较，同时成本换算会纳入不同阶段的提示和生成长度差异。其扩展原语是带融合的重复采样：样本以 0.9 温度生成，再由同一个语言模型融合候选响应，从而避免额外的奖励模型或验证器。

搜索智能体从模型偏好试验开始，接收执行反馈，将其存入档案，并把三条经验指引转化为后续提案的规则。环境在实际任务平台执行每个候选分配。报告的实验覆盖基于检索的问答、知识图谱问答、任务自动化和自动软件开发，共六个数据集；每种方法在 50 个训练样本上运行 50 次搜索迭代，并在 500 个测试样本上评估，搜索智能体为 GPT-o3-mini。官方仓库包含四类任务的数据和改写后的执行代码。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates six datasets across four workflow types and compares AgentTTS with random search, Bayesian optimization, zero-shot LLM allocation, MLCopilot, and AgentHPO. It reports that AgentTTS reaches top results on most tasks with fewer trials. On 2WikiMultiHopQA, the reported test score is 0.72, exceeding the next best result of 0.70; the table also reports 2.5 hours of search for AgentTTS versus 8.3 to 12.5 hours for the listed LLM-based baselines that produced a score of 0.70.

The ablations support the paper’s three planning inputs: removing model-preference initialization prevents the reported search from reaching an optimal configuration, while omitting diminishing-return or dependency guidance delays the best trial. These results demonstrate search efficiency under the authors’ model pool, FLOPs normalization, 50-example search set, and task metrics. They do not establish a universal allocation policy, because the location of an optimum depends on model prices, fusion behavior, task ordering, and the evaluation environment.

论文在四类工作流的六个数据集上评估，并将 AgentTTS 与随机搜索、贝叶斯优化、零样本语言模型分配、MLCopilot 和 AgentHPO 比较。结果报告 AgentTTS 在多数任务上以更少试验达到最高表现。在 2WikiMultiHopQA 上，报告的测试分数为 0.72，高于次优的 0.70；表格还报告 AgentTTS 的搜索时间为 2.5 小时，而得到 0.70 分数的所列语言模型基线需要 8.3 至 12.5 小时。

消融实验支持论文的三项规划输入：移除模型偏好初始化会使报告的搜索无法达到最优配置，省略边际递减或依赖关系指引则会推迟最佳试验。这些结果证明的是作者模型池、FLOPs 归一化、50 个样本的搜索集和任务指标下的搜索效率。它们并未给出普适分配策略，因为最优点的位置取决于模型价格、融合行为、任务排序和评估环境。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest repeated-sampling and best-of-n methods choose how much computation to use for one prediction. AgentTTS instead makes the allocation cross-stage: it jointly selects a model and sample count for every subtask, then evaluates the entire workflow under one budget. It also treats upstream quality as part of the downstream scaling curve, which is essential when retrieval, planning, coding, or tool selection changes the input received by a later model.

Its distinct contribution is not a new verifier or a better response fusion rule. It is an execution-feedback search scaffold that converts model-size preference, diminishing returns, and inter-stage dependence into stored guidelines for an LLM search agent. This makes the allocation procedure inspectable through its archive of trials and explanations. The result is still an optimization framework, so its guidance must be re-estimated when the available models, prices, stages, or evaluation rules change.

最接近的重复采样和最优多样本方法，决定的是为一次预测使用多少计算。AgentTTS 则把分配扩展到跨阶段：它为每个子任务联合选择模型和样本数，再在一个总预算下评估整个工作流。它还把上游质量视为下游扩展曲线的一部分；当检索、规划、编码或工具选择改变后续模型接收的输入时，这一点尤为关键。

其独特贡献不是新的验证器或更好的响应融合规则，而是一个基于执行反馈的搜索框架，把模型规模偏好、边际递减和阶段间依赖转化为语言模型搜索智能体可保存的指引。这样，人们能够通过其试验和解释档案检查分配过程。结果仍是一个优化框架，因此当可用模型、价格、阶段或评估规则发生变化时，相关指引必须重新估计。

title: Limitations
局限
html: AgentTTS relies on repeated execution of candidate workflows, so the search itself can be costly and the quality of its result depends on a representative small feedback set. FLOPs normalize model and token costs but cannot substitute for wall-clock latency, API availability, queueing, tool failures, or actual price. The agent’s textual guidelines do not prove causal explanations, and same-model fusion can become a bottleneck as candidate count grows. The method also assumes the workflow stages and allowable model pool are known; changing a retriever, tool interface, ordering, or evaluator changes the search surface and requires a fresh allocation study.

AgentTTS 依赖反复执行候选工作流，因此搜索本身可能成本很高，结果质量也取决于具有代表性的小型反馈集。FLOPs 能够归一化模型和 token 成本，却不能代替实际运行时间延迟、接口可用性、排队、工具失败或真实价格。智能体给出的文字指引并不能证明因果解释；当候选数量增加时，同模型融合也可能成为瓶颈。该方法还假设工作流阶段和允许的模型池已知；更换检索器、工具接口、顺序或判定器都会改变搜索表面，并需要重新进行分配研究。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when a product has a sequence of LLM stages and a single serving budget must be divided among them. Record the task graph, candidate models, model versions, each stage’s prompt and generation length, sample count, fusion prompt, normalized and actual cost, upstream outputs, downstream inputs, per-stage score, final score, search trial, and search-set versus held-out-set result. A credible deployment comparison should report both the chosen allocation’s end-to-end latency and cost, because an allocation that is FLOPs-efficient may still be impractical under a particular API or tool stack.
当产品具有一系列语言模型阶段，并且必须在它们之间分割单一服务预算时，本论文很有用。应记录任务图、候选模型、模型版本、每个阶段的提示与生成长度、样本数、融合提示、归一化和实际成本、上游输出、下游输入、各阶段分数、最终分数、搜索试验，以及搜索集与保留集结果。可信的部署比较还应报告所选分配的端到端延迟和成本，因为 FLOPs 高效的分配在特定接口或工具栈下仍可能不切实际。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the paper with the total-budget constraint in view. Separate the empirical observations about model preference, saturation, and dependency from the agentic search mechanism that exploits them. Then inspect how cost is normalized, how the same model fuses repeated samples, which trials were allowed, and whether a training-set allocation survives on held-out tasks. The most useful transfer is the logging discipline: treat every stage allocation as an experimental record whose downstream consequences must be measured, rather than optimizing each component in isolation.
阅读论文时应始终关注总预算约束。先将关于模型偏好、饱和和依赖关系的经验观察，与利用这些观察的智能体搜索机制分开。随后检查成本如何归一化、同一个模型如何融合重复样本、允许哪些试验，以及在训练集上找到的分配能否在保留任务上成立。最有用的迁移是日志纪律：把每个阶段分配视为必须测量其下游后果的实验记录，而不是孤立地优化每个组件。
